guard_contract.MEASUREMENT_CONTEXT: Portfolio/business absolute totals remain context unless a single installation scope is explicitly reported.
guard_contract.ABATEMENT_CONTEXT: Projected reductions, avoided emissions and energy savings are not observed emissions.
guard_contract.BINDING_CANDIDATE: Permit/address/operator identity strengthens facility binding only and supplies no measured GHG value.
guard_contract.SOURCE_UPGRADE: Project/method narrative cannot substitute for a direct dated installation emission row.

web_research_basis: Fresh official/public internet research on 2026-07-27 using British Sugar, DESNZ/GOV.UK and Environment Agency sources. British Sugar 2024/25 Scope 1/2 totals are retained at business-portfolio scope; Wissington and Prax IETF metrics remain abatement/engineering context; four British Sugar factory permits strengthen England onshore binding. No portfolio-to-factory allocation, intensity conversion, baseline inversion or fabricated UK ETS row was used.
